$comment: Mini campaign for the new MV+LV distribution scaling grid (simbench_mvlv,
1-MVLV-urban-5.303, ~778 MES nodes / 45 CPs). Mirrors the eval_full scaling
pillar (scare vs oracle, the two clean scenarios, 45% slack budget) but at a
small seed count and with the LV large grid alongside as a size-scaling
reference. Purpose: confirm the retuned gas/heat overlay runs end-to-end
through the full restoration + oracle pipeline (not just a one-shot solve)
and see how PWSF / compliance land vs the established LV grid.
name: eval_mvlv_mini
